baslik: The Day Humans First Flew Freely 🎈 November 21, 1783 #onthisday
aciklama:
On November 21, 1783, Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d'Arlandes made the first free human flight in a hot air balloon over Paris. King Louis XVI had wanted two condemned prisoners to go first...

One minute of history, every day.
